### Important Findings

#### Finding 1: Direct Documentation Contradiction in Host Summary Table
- **Source Anchor:** [docs/host-integration.md#L15](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/docs/host-integration.md#L15) vs. [docs/host-integration.md#L25-31](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/docs/host-integration.md#L25-31) and [README.md#L10, L19](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/README.md#L10).
- **Issue:** The main summary table under `## Observed beta.2 smoke` in [docs/host-integration.md](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/docs/host-integration.md) retains line 15:
  ```markdown
  | OpenCode | Not run in this beta lane | Unassessed; no model or paid fallback |
  ```
  Immediately below at line 25, a new section `## Follow-up: native OpenCode 2 / Vilao` is added documenting the observed execution on native OpenCode 2.2.5. Furthermore, [README.md#L10](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/README.md#L10) and [README.md#L19](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/README.md#L19) explicitly state:
  > *"Native Windows Codex and OpenCode 2/Vilao explicit repo-scope ZIP invocations were observed... See [host integration evidence](docs/host-integration.md)..."*
  A reader following the link encounters an un-updated summary table that explicitly claims OpenCode was "Not run in this beta lane".
- **Remediation:** Update table line 15 in [docs/host-integration.md](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/docs/host-integration.md) or add a row clarifying that native OpenCode 2.2.5 was observed in the follow-up lane (retaining the unassessed status for earlier WSL 1.x / implicit discovery).

#### Finding 2: Asymmetry in Structured Metrics for Initial GLM Invalid-Switch Failure
- **Source Anchor:** [evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/resources.json#L91-120](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/resources.json#L91-120) vs. [evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/README.md#L22-23](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/README.md#L22-23).
- **Issue:** In [README.md#L22](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/README.md#L22), the table reports the GLM completed creator initial pass failed the submitted-invalid switch cases with `0 / 12` ([evidence/glm-initial-invalid-switch-submitted/report.json](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/evidence/glm-initial-invalid-switch-submitted/report.json)), improving to `12 / 0` after correction ([README.md#L23](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/README.md#L23)). However, in [resources.json](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/.tmp/lon99-20261108/pr3-packet/evals/runs/2026-11-03-opencode-vilao-host-smoke/resources.json#L103-120):
